title: Smile and Harvest
author: Jude Brightwater
blurb: Dominic Voss, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
